stem: A company generates a 4-character code using the 26 letters of the alphabet and the 10 digits 0-9. The code is in the form letter-digit-letter-digit.

subquestions.prompt_template: Determine how many codes can be formed if letters and digits may be repeated.
How many codes if: letters D, F, I, Q, U, V may NOT be used; code may NOT start with W or Z; letters or digits may NOT be repeated; code ends with an odd digit.
steps: First letter: from 26 - 6 = 20 letters, minus W,Z = 18.

subquestions.prompt_template: Calculate the percentage increase if D, F, I, Q, U, V are now allowed.
